m13.text: Kaalia of the Vast begins as Lia, who learns from the nacatl Sunstriker Nira that a demon is harvesting bones for a ritual and has taken her village and family to the ruins.
Nira reveals that Lia is a stonekiller whom she needs to destroy the dragon skeleton's keystone, and gives her the warrior name Kaa-lia.

Imagining herself by the river on Bant, Kaalia destroys the keystone, the skeleton falls and kills the bald man, and Nira cushions her fall but tells her to flee because the rest of the Sunstrikers are lost.
The demon rises from the rift and slaughters the survivors, and Kaalia awakes to devastation, learns that the demon escaped, and vows revenge.

cmr.text: In Commander Legends, shadowy beings massacre Kaalia of the Vast's congregation, and her once-simple life as a cleric is reduced to ashes as she survives with a fractured soul.
